runs.name: g3-mainsnap-load
runs.description: main's snapshot (96-word cells, 188-word genomes) loads into G3 with the moire genome off

evals.js: return JSON.stringify({g3: moire.folding.params.on, notes: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.notes, exact: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.exact})

runs.name: g3-oldsnap
runs.description: an old snapshot (tissue lab) loads with the moire genome off

evals.js: return JSON.stringify({g3: moire.folding.params.on, notes: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.notes.filter(n => n.includes('G3'))})

runs.name: g3-selfsnap-make
runs.description: G3 on: colonies s3, a snapshot at 60 s

runs.name: g3-selfsnap-load
runs.description: ... loads back with G3 on, lattices kept

evals.js: const c = await moire.folding.now(); return JSON.stringify({g3: moire.folding.params.on, exact: moire.lab.loaded && moire.lab.loaded.exact, derived: c.derived, drift: c.drift, sf: c.stressFold})
